title: Global Stability of 3D Compressible Non-Resistive MHD: Hidden Damping and Rational Background Fields
summary: We prove the global well-posedness and nonlinear stability of classical solutions to the three-dimensional compressible viscous, non-resistive MHD system on $\mathbb{T}^3$ near the equilibrium $(1,\mathbf{0},\mathbf{e}_3)$, for small $x_3$-symmetric perturbations and without any Diophantine condition on the background magnetic field. The central obstruction is the $x_3$-independent sector, in which the density and the magnetic field possess no dissipation, no damping, and no decay. We overcome it by exhibiting a hidden wave structure for the exact total pressure…
